% Pattern: head/name. After the title of a statement, "of" or "to" and the
% item it follows from name it, as {\it Corollaries of Family $S_1$} or
% {\it Corollary to Family F$_2$}, and the plural title is a title too. Seen
% in the gold pilot (set X).
% want head-1 statement/corollary -
% want head-2 statement/corollary -
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Some words.

\noindent {\it Corollaries of Family $S_1$}

Let $d$ be odd.

\noindent {\it Corollary to Family F$_2$}

Let $d$ be even.
\end{document}
